description: Golden trajectory set for CauterRule v0.1.0 regression testing

G-001-git-push-non-ff.expected_rule: when git push fails with non-fast-forward, pull latest changes before pushing

G-002-python-import.expected_rule: when python import fails with ModuleNotFoundError, install the missing package

G-003-docker-build.expected_rule: when docker build fails with package not found, add apt-get install to Dockerfile

G-004-pip-conflict.expected_rule: when pip install fails with version conflict, pin compatible versions in requirements

G-005-kubectl-crd.expected_rule: when kubectl apply fails with NotFound, install the CRD first

G-006-test-assertion.expected_rule: when test assertion fails, compare expected and actual values to identify the mismatch

G-007-api-rate-limit.expected_rule: when API returns 429, implement exponential backoff before retrying

G-008-terraform-lock.expected_rule: when terraform plan fails with state lock, run terraform force-unlock to release the lock

G-009-selenium-element.expected_rule: when browser element not found, wait for page load or check selector for correctness

G-010-deploy-timeout.expected_rule: when deployment health check times out, check the endpoint directly and increase timeout if needed
